strings.launcher.asset_library.title: Asset Library
strings.launcher.asset_library.coming_soon: The asset library is loading. Connect to GitHub to browse community projects.
strings.launcher.asset_library.engine_newer: Built for Funke {0} — may need migration
strings.launcher.asset_library.done.title: Download Complete
strings.launcher.asset_library.done.body: The project has been downloaded and added to your projects.
strings.launcher.asset_library.error.verificatio: Archive verification failed. The library index may be out of date.
strings.launcher.asset_library.error.no_project_: Archive doesn't contain a Funke project (no project.json).
strings.launcher.asset_library.error.untrusted_h: Refusing to download from a non-GitHub host.
strings.launcher.asset_library.trust.title: Community content
strings.launcher.asset_library.trust.body: Projects from the asset library are community content. They include code that runs on your machine when the project is opened. Review the scripts under Scripts/ before clicking Open.
strings.launcher.list.empty.title: No projects yet
strings.launcher.list.empty.subtitle: Create a new project or add an existing one.
strings.launcher.create.template.none: No project templates found. An empty 2D project is created.
strings.launcher.create.template.hint: Tip: right-click a project and choose "Save as Template" to add your own templates.
strings.launcher.create.template.manage_hint: Right-click a custom template to show or delete it.
strings.launcher.template_save.title: Save as Template
strings.launcher.template_save.subtitle: Stores the Assets/ structure, project settings, build profiles, native scripts and local packages of '{0}' as a reusable template. Unsaved editor changes are not included.
strings.launcher.template_save.name: Template name:
strings.launcher.template_save.saved: Template '{0}' saved. It is now available when creating a new project.
strings.launcher.template_delete.title: Delete Template
strings.launcher.template_delete.message: Delete the template '{0}'? Projects created from it are not affected.
strings.launcher.templates.create_from_project_t: Save one of your projects as a new template
strings.launcher.templates.custom_empty: No custom templates yet. Use "From Project" or right-click a project and choose "Save as Template".
strings.launcher.templates.refresh_unavailable: The source project was not found. Set it under "Edit...".
strings.launcher.template_edit.title: Edit Template
strings.launcher.template_edit.subtitle: Changes the name and details. To change the content, open the source project, edit and save it, then choose "Update from Source Project".
strings.launcher.template_edit.source_invalid: This folder is not a Funke project.
strings.launcher.template_refresh.title: Update Template
strings.launcher.template_refresh.message: Replace the content of '{0}' with the current state of its source project?
strings.launcher.template_refresh.note: Assets, project settings, build profiles, native scripts and local packages are copied again; name and description stay. Unsaved editor changes are not included.

strings.launcher.delete.body: This will permanently delete the project folder from disk and remove it from the launcher list.
strings.launcher.delete_final.title: Permanently Delete Project?
strings.launcher.delete_final.body: This action cannot be undone. The folder below will be deleted from disk.
strings.launcher.create.title: Create New Project
strings.launcher.create.init_git.tooltip: Runs `git init` in the new project folder and writes a Funke-tailored .gitignore. Requires git on PATH.
